name: Seared NY Strip with Spicy Celery, Cucumber & Cilantro "Tiger Salad"

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 small bunches cilantro
9 sticks celery
1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl along with soy sauce, oil, chili-garlic sauce, and sugar. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside for serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, oil, sugar, and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup rice vinegar
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, thinly slice jalapeño peppers crosswise into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level (optional). Add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and slice green onions on the diagonal into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and slice celery on the diagonal into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and add the leaves to the bowl. Stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Drizzle sauce over the steak and enjoy!
